profile: You favour psychedelic neuroscience in humans and animals, especially psilocybin, LSD, DMT and breathwork, examined through EEG, sleep physiology, PET receptor and synaptic density binding, and whole-brain dynamics such as criticality, vortex and control-energy models. Heart-brain coupling, meditation states and ketamine combined with neuromodulation also draw your attention. Clinical trial readouts in depression and mechanistic pharmacology of 5-HT2A signalling fit well. You are less interested in glymphatic and CSF clearance physiology, and in funding or conference announcements that lack methodological content.
